correctness.rationale: The full 105-source/15-output incidence structure is generated twice and cross-checked. Subset DP with a provably disjoint partition counts maximum disjoint-shadow codebooks and an independent clique method agrees at all four sizes. A 7-word witness and exact half-unit dual cover prove integer optimum 7, while feasible primal source and dual output weights of total 15 half-units give fractional optimum 15/2. Reflection counts are exhaustively computed and Burnside applied to the two-element group. All checks replay from the bundled verify.py and CERTIFICATES.json.

value.rationale: Unknown matched-pair loss is a natural event on rooted chord diagrams, fixed-point-free involutions and paired-endpoint encodings. The first strict fractional LP gap at four pairs and exact 278-codebook classification supply a substantive finite sharp benchmark for zero-error reconstruction. The precise finite capacity, fractional certificate, and reversal equality classes are not merely restatements of known generic bounds; no bigger-order assertion is made.
